fields.name: user
fields.coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request; the prefix `US_` is added if it is missing
fields.description: The account id. It becomes `player.owner`.

fields.name: auth
fields.coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request
fields.description: The session auth token. It must be in the `auths` list of the account.

fields.name: character
fields.coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request; the prefix `CH_` is added if it is missing
fields.description: The id of the character to start (the `id` from the character list, not the name).

fields.name: code_slot
fields.description: The CODE slot to load. If no slot has that key, the server looks for a slot whose file name matches (`find_code_slot`, adventure_functions.js:140-153). The code comes back in `start`.

fields.name: passphrase
fields.description: Only on a server with `gameplay == "test"`, where it is required. It must be `"potato salad"`.

fields.name: bot
fields.coerce: compared with `==` to the `BOT_MASTER` key of the server
fields.description: If it matches, the character becomes a bot (`afk: "bot"`).

fields.name: no_html
fields.description: Marks the session as a code client (`afk: "code"`). If the value is the name of a character online on this server, that name becomes `player.controller`; else `controller` is `""`.

fields.name: epl
fields.description: The platform. `"mas"` needs `receipt`; `"steam"` needs `ticket`; `"tauri_steam"` uses `ticket` or a Steam id that the account saved before. Any other value, or `"mas"`/`"steam"` without its field, means web.

fields.name: receipt
fields.description: A Mac App Store receipt, for `epl: "mas"`.

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: A Steam ticket, for `epl: "steam"` or `"tauri_steam"`.

fields.name: mainframe_session
fields.description: The server checks it against the mainframe assignment of the character (`is_valid_mainframe_session`). A mismatch fails the login with `mainframe_issue`.

confirm.note: ALClient sends `user` and `character` with their `US_` / `CH_` prefixes and `passphrase: ""` (live capture)

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The character is in the game.
responses.summary: The full client object of the character (`player_to_client`), plus `ipass`, `home`, `friends`, `acx`, `xcx`, `info`, `base_gold`, `s_info` and `entities` (everything that you can see now). `blessed_by` and `blessed_minutes` are there when the server has a blessing. `code`, `code_slot` and `code_version` are there when a code slot loaded. See `start`.

confirm.live_needed: The `player_to_client` object and `entities` depend on the character and what is near it; the `start` capture checks them.

responses.name: Tauri Steam
responses.when: `epl: "tauri_steam"` and the Steam check succeeds. It comes before `start`.

fields.name: status
fields.description: `persisted_steam_id`: the account had a Steam id saved. `steam_ticket_verified`: the server verified `ticket`.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The Steam id. It becomes the `pid` of the character.

fields.name: ticket_received
fields.description: `true` when the request has a truthy `ticket`.

responses.name: Tauri Steam error
responses.when: `epl: "tauri_steam"` and the Steam check fails. The login continues as web and ends with `start`.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: `steam_auth_failed`: the ticket did not verify, or the check threw. `steam_link_failed`: the server could not save the Steam id to the account.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The step that failed. `verify_ticket` goes with `steam_auth_failed`; the other two go with `steam_link_failed`.

fields.name: ticket_received
fields.description: `true` when the request has a truthy `ticket`.

failures.intro: No failure is a `game_response`. Each `game_log` and each `game_error` (except `"ERROR!"`) is a `LocalizedText`; this table quotes its English `message`.

rows.when: The payload is not an object, or `user`, `character` or `auth` is not a string.
A test server (`gameplay == "test"`) and `passphrase` is not `"potato salad"`.
This socket has a login in progress, or the character has a login in progress.
The character is in the disconnect queue (`dc_players`), or it is online on this server.
The server is not live, the socket is not an observer (no `loaded` yet), or the socket has a character already.

example.message: Can't accept more than 200 players at this time

rows.when: The database claim fails. `reason`: `no_character` (no such character, or not on your account), `password_issue` (wrong `auth` or no account), `mainframe_issue`, `ingame` (the character is online on a server), `cancelled` (the login was cancelled or passed 60 s), or `exception` (a database error).
A poker hand of the character still runs on another server.

example.message: Your poker hand is still running on another server. Wait for it to finish, or reconnect there.

rows.when: The server cannot confirm your other characters (`encouragement_login`).

example.message: Could not confirm your other characters. Please try again.

rows.when: The server became full during the login.

example.message: Can't accept more than 200 players at this time

rows.when: The account is over its limits (`is_player_allowed`, node/server_functions.js:383): for example a second merchant of the account on this server.
After the claim: the socket disconnects, the observer goes away, the server stops being live, or the 60 s deadline passes (`check_character_login`). Or any other error in the login.

replies.note: a bare string, only if the socket is still connected

rows.when: The login takes more than 60 s (`character_login_timeout`) at any point. The server sends no message.

also.to: every character of your account online on this server, you included
also.when: Later, after `start`, one time per account: the server sends the Tracktrix mail (when the account has not got it yet).

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code. There is no `place`.

fields.name: count
fields.description: The number of unread mails of the account after the Tracktrix mail, up to 100 (`update_mail_count`).

confirm.note: `count` is undefined (no reply) when the mail was not sent

also.to: your friends: each online character, on any server, whose `friends` holds your account
also.when: Later, after `start`, when the account has friends and the character is not `private`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Your name.

fields.name: server
fields.description: The region and the name of this server, for example `"EU I"`.

order: later: `game_response` `mail_received` to the characters of your account (one time per account), and `online` to your friends
